text: 记者获悉，上交所近期向全体沪市上市公司发布《上海证券交易所上市公司董事会秘书履职规则理解一本通（2026年修订）》，此次修订工作进一步整理了新规实施以来上市公司咨询较多的问题，包括董秘职责范围、任职资格、兼任限制、过渡期安排等，旨在帮助上市公司准确把握董秘新规要点，进一步促进和保障董事会秘书履职。根据新规，董秘任职与兼职调整过渡期安排至2027年12月31日，目前已有不少上市公司完成任职调整。上交所表示，将继续做好董秘新规落地实施工作，引导上市公司有序进行过渡期高管任职调整，持续推动上市公司完善治理。（界面）
text_en: The reporter learned that the SSE recently issued to all listed companies on the Shanghai market the "SSE Listed Company Board Secretary Performance of Duties Rules Comprehension Guide (2026 Revision)." This revision further compiled the issues most frequently consulted by listed companies since the implementation of the new rules, including the scope of the board secretary's duties, qualifications, concurrent appointment restrictions, and transitional arrangements, aiming to help listed companies accurately grasp the key points of the new board secretary rules and further promote and safeguard the performance of duties by board secretaries. According to the new rules, the transitional arrangement for adjustments to board secretary appointments and concurrent positions has been set until December 31, 2027, and many listed companies have already completed appointment adjustments. The SSE stated that it will continue to do a good job in implementing the new board secretary rules, guide listed companies to carry out orderly adjustments to senior management appointments during the transition period, and continue to promote the improvement of corporate governance among listed companies. (Jiemian)
